0.name: TEXT_REGWILBLACKBRASH_00042_ELURED_000_1
0.description: I'm a busy man, so state your business or leave me to mine.

3.name: TEXT_REGWILBLACKBRASH_00042_SCENE00000A2
3.description: What is the purpose of the station?

5.name: TEXT_REGWILBLACKBRASH_00042_ELURED_000_10
5.description: I oversee all operations here at Black Brush Station. Have been doing so since it was constructed.

6.name: TEXT_REGWILBLACKBRASH_00042_ELURED_000_11
6.description: Shipments of ore arrive daily, and we have to unload and sort it all for the furnaces.

7.name: TEXT_REGWILBLACKBRASH_00042_ELURED_000_12
7.description: Takes a strong back and sure hands. I should know─used to be a smelter myself, until the Calamity crippled my arm and put an end to that.

8.name: TEXT_REGWILBLACKBRASH_00042_ELURED_000_20
8.description: We extract metal from ore. Bronze, silver, mythril─you name it, we smelt it.

9.name: TEXT_REGWILBLACKBRASH_00042_ELURED_000_21
9.description: See all that smoke? It comes from our furnaces. We keep them burning day and night with a steady supply of fire crystals.

10.name: TEXT_REGWILBLACKBRASH_00042_ELURED_000_22
10.description: Aye, without me and my boys sweating it out here, the lords and ladies wouldn't be able to deck themselves out in fancy baubles.
